Solara — (9.2) NEBULA

TRUE POLARIS

"True Polaris -- you waited and we came"

[Intro — silence, then a single note of light]

[Verse 1]

Level twenty-four was not what she expected

She had expected a wall — a fight

Something that explained why everyone wanted them to stop

What she found instead was a star

Cracked — dimmed — flickering

The way something flickers when it has been holding on

For a very long time

Waiting for something it was not sure would come

And then it felt her

And it held on a little harder

[Pre-Chorus — crew around her, no words, just presence]

The crew went still

(The Hero said nothing)(The Hunter said nothing)

(The Swan was not dancing)(Aldric closed his notes)

(The Queen stood very straight)(Castor moved closer)

(The Laborer bowed his head)

And SOLARA put her hand out toward the light

And felt Elara

Not the name — not the memory

But the feeling of a woman who ran toward the north

Who never stopped running

Who promised a star she would come back

And could not keep that promise

SOLARA kept it for her

[Chorus]

True Polaris — you waited and we came

True Polaris — we carry every name

Of everyone who tried to reach you

Everyone who fell before

True Polaris — we see you

We see what they have done

And we are making one promise here —

We will find what broke you

We will bring you home

No matter what comes

No matter how far

No matter who tries to stop us

True Polaris — we swear

[Verse 2]

The light that reached her was old light

She knew this — light travel rules

What she was seeing had left Polaris long before she got here

Which meant the present wound was worse

And still it held on (for her)(specifically)

(it had been holding on)(since before she knew)(what she was)

[Bridge — SOLARA speaks to the star and to Elara through it]

She said: I do not know what did this

She said: I know it is connected

To every higher state that pushed back

Every bounty on our heads

Every wall at every level that said stop here — go back — this is forbidden

She said: but you held on

You held on until I came

And I am here

And I am not leaving

Until I find what broke you

And I bring you back

Whatever it costs — whatever it takes — whatever comes next

(the star flickered)(brighter)(just for a moment)(like something exhaled)

[Final Chorus — all eight voices]

True Polaris — you waited and we came

True Polaris — we carry every name

Of everyone who tried to reach you

Everyone who fell before

True Polaris — we see you — we see what they have done

And we are making one promise here —

(Castor:) We will find it

(The Queen:) We will end it

(The Hunter:) We will track it down

(The Hero:) We will face it

(The Laborer:) We will lift it

(The Swan:) We will carry every sound

(Aldric:) We will map it

(All:) WE WILL BRING YOU HOME

True Polaris

No matter what comes

No matter how far

No matter who tries to stop us

True Polaris — we swear

[Outro]

The star did not go out — it held

And SOLARA stood at level twenty-four

With seven people behind her

And a promise ahead of her

And somewhere far above in another fold

Asala and Basala looked at each other

Basala said: she made the pact

Asala said: yes

And neither of them spoke for a very long time
